earth_reference: area-weighted Earth land cells of data/processed/earth_features.nc
earth_limits: Earth cannot reproduce reduced gravity, vacuum or thin atmosphere, or the radiation environment.

moon_south_pole.name: Lunar south pole (poleward of 85S)
moon_south_pole.region: disk of radius 151.7 km around the pole in the Moon 2015 polar stereographic grid
moon_south_pole.method: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ area-averaged to a 2 km grid; Earth estimators applied; median and p10-p90 over the disk
moon_south_pole.resolution_note: 80 m source, 2 km working grid, windows 5-32 km

temp_mean_c.limitation: Moon: Diviner SURFACE temperature (annual mean) vs Earth AIR temperature (WorldClim, annual mean); different quantities, and the Moon is far colder than any Earth cell, so this feature only ranks Earth by coldness.

temp_diurnal_range_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

temp_max_warmest_c.limitation: Moon: Diviner SURFACE temperature (annual maximum) vs Earth AIR temperature (WorldClim, mean daily max of warmest month); different quantities, and the Moon is far colder than any Earth cell, so this feature only ranks Earth by coldness.

temp_min_coldest_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

temp_annual_range_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

precip_annual_mm.limitation: Airless body: no precipitation by definition. Treated as 'drier than any Earth desert', not a measured value.

precip_driest_month_mm.limitation: Airless body: no precipitation by definition. Treated as 'drier than any Earth desert', not a measured value.

diviner_thermal.source: LRO Diviner south polar resource product DLRE_PRP_SOUTH v2 (PDS)
diviner_thermal.cold_trap_definition: area fraction with annual maximum surface temperature < 110 K

ice_cold_trap_proxy.limitation: PSR table lists shadowed areas > 1 km2 only (lower bound); CRS assumed equal to the DEM grid. Earth has no PSR analogue; its proxy temp_min_coldest_c is a different quantity.

equator_surface_temp_min.source: NASA NSSDC Moon Fact Sheet (updated 2024-01-11) https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html; equatorial night minimum, NOT south pole

equator_surface_temp_max.source: NASA NSSDC Moon Fact Sheet (updated 2024-01-11) https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html; equatorial day maximum, NOT south pole

equator_diurnal_range.source: derived: 390 K - 95 K from the NASA NSSDC Moon Fact Sheet; equatorial, NOT south pole

cold_trap_annual_max_temp_threshold.source: Sefton-Nash et al. 2019 Icarus doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2019.06.002; annual maximum surface temperature below 110 K allows persistent surface water ice (Diviner)

mars_jezero.name: Jezero Crater, Mars
mars_jezero.method: MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd reprojected (bilinear) to a 2 km azimuthal equidistant grid on R=3396.19 km; Earth estimators applied; median and p10-p90 over the disk
mars_jezero.resolution_note: 3.7 km source, 2 km working grid: sub-pixel detail is not resolved

relief_20km_m.limitation: 3.7 km MOLA pixels bilinearly resampled to 2 km smooth fine-scale terrain, biasing slope and roughness low.

slope_20km_deg.limitation: 3.7 km MOLA pixels bilinearly resampled to 2 km smooth fine-scale terrain, biasing slope and roughness low.

roughness_5km_m.limitation: 5 km window is about 1.4 MOLA pixels (3.7 km); value is not comparable with Earth's 1.85 km source and is an underestimate.

roughness_10km_m.limitation: 3.7 km MOLA pixels bilinearly resampled to 2 km smooth fine-scale terrain, biasing slope and roughness low.

roughness_20km_m.limitation: 3.7 km MOLA pixels bilinearly resampled to 2 km smooth fine-scale terrain, biasing slope and roughness low.

hurst_2_32km.limitation: Lags 2 and 4 km are below MOLA resolution; fitted over 8/16/32 km only, so the exponent is indicative.

temp_mean_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

temp_diurnal_range_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

temp_max_warmest_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

temp_min_coldest_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

temp_annual_range_c.limitation: No site-specific cited value yet; reference values below are equatorial/global and must not be used as the target.

precip_annual_mm.limitation: Hyper-arid: no liquid precipitation. Treated as a one-sided constraint, not a measured value.

precip_driest_month_mm.limitation: Hyper-arid: no liquid precipitation. Treated as a one-sided constraint, not a measured value.

global_mean_temp.source: NASA NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet (updated 2025-05-19) https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/marsfact.html; global average, NOT Jezero

viking1_diurnal_temp_min.source: NASA NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet (updated 2025-05-19); Viking 1 lander site, NOT Jezero

viking1_diurnal_temp_max.source: NASA NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet (updated 2025-05-19); Viking 1 lander site, NOT Jezero

viking1_diurnal_range.source: derived: 242 K - 184 K from the NASA NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet; Viking 1 lander site, NOT Jezero

ice_cold_trap_proxy.limitation: No mapped cold-trap product downloaded for Mars.
